notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
This update introduces two optional secret bosses for players willing to dig a little deeper:

[list]
[*] Stormcloak
[*] Obsidian Sentinel
[/list]

They are powerful, well-hidden, and not part of the main path. You’ll have to explore thoroughly — and be ready for a challenge.

We’ve also applied many bug fixes and gameplay tweaks based on community feedback. These aren’t listed here in detail, but they should make the experience smoother overall.

Thank you for playing. If you enjoy the update, consider leaving a review — it helps more than you’d think.

Good luck out there. You’ll need it.

notes.title: Summer Sale and New Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

During the quiet month of May, we were focused on working on Taram Baba’s updates and the PlayStation version.

On June 26th, alongside the Steam Summer Sale, the biggest update ever released for Taram Baba will go live. We’re bringing new content and improvements to make the game better.

Don’t miss the summer sale and the update. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch 5
notes.content:
Finally fixed the bug regarding on-screen messages not matching the input device.

More updates are on the way.

notes.title: Patch 4
notes.content:
With this update:
[list]
[*] The gamepad LS Up button can no longer be used for jumping
[*] The double jump feature is now easier to use
[*] Some descriptions are improved
[*] The platforming tutorial is improved
[*] The visible area on the screen is increased
[/list]

I am still working on issues like:
[list]
[*] Font consistency and text sizes in all languages
[*] Better explanation of the game's features
[*] Better colors, lighting, and other visual improvements
[*] Better keyboard and controller support
[*] Translation improvements
[*] Replayability improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
- Edited rooms that could potentially soft-lock the game
- You can now continue where you left off in your previous game by pressing the “Continue” button.

notes.title: Day-Two Patch Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a room combination that soft locked the game.
- Fixed an issue with the minimap.

Thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Day-One Patch Update
notes.content:
Hey!

This is the first of many updates I am planning to release.

I am here to fix any bugs or add any features you mention. If you open a discussion, leave a comment, or contact any of the social media accounts on the store page, I am more than happy to update the game accordingly.
